structure.note: closed lists, read from engine/program/names.py and engine/sheet/names.py

names.name: form:show
names.definition: reads a labelled cell, or lists the values on the kept lines

names.name: form:agg
names.definition: one figure over the kept lines

names.name: form:rank
names.definition: the top line, group or peer column

names.name: form:calc
names.definition: the difference, sum or ratio of two one-number programs

names.name: size:signed
names.definition: a figure read with its sign

names.name: size:by_size
names.definition: a group or peer ranks by the size of its total

names.name: size:each
names.definition: a measure read line by line with its sign dropped

names.name: size:stated
names.definition: the signed result stated by its size

names.name: entity:line
names.definition: the line holding the top value

names.name: entity:group
names.definition: the key whose lines add up highest

names.name: entity:peer
names.definition: the peer column holding the top value

names.name: row_op:+
names.definition: two measures of one line added

names.name: row_op:-
names.definition: one measure of a line less another

names.name: row_op:*
names.definition: two measures of one line multiplied

names.name: row_op:/
names.definition: one measure of a line over another

names.name: word_role:measure
names.definition: the word names what is measured

names.name: word_role:key
names.definition: the word names what is grouped by or shown

names.name: word_role:context
names.definition: the word names the sheet, the tab or its subject

names.name: condition:period
names.definition: a date falls in this period

names.name: condition:comparison
names.definition: a number compares with a number stated

names.name: condition:blank
names.definition: a cell is blank or filled

names.name: condition:section
names.definition: a band above the line says this

names.name: condition:line
names.definition: a line's own label holds this

names.name: condition:not_equals
names.definition: a text cell is some other value

names.name: anchor:anywhere
names.definition: the text sits anywhere in the cell

names.name: measure_kind:row_arithmetic
names.definition: two columns of one line under an operator

names.name: measure_kind:size
names.definition: a measure with its sign dropped

names.name: measure_kind:date
names.definition: a date column read as its day

names.name: measure_kind:across
names.definition: peer columns of one line added

names.name: column_role:key
names.definition: text naming the record, mostly distinct

names.name: column_role:section_label
names.definition: a sparse label filled down over the lines under it

names.name: column_role:peer
names.definition: one of several columns of one axis

names.name: column_role:tab_name
names.definition: the tab a family member came from

names.name: line_role:subtotal
names.definition: a printed summary of part of a table

names.name: line_role:total
names.definition: a printed summary of a whole table

names.name: line_role:band
names.definition: a section label over the lines under it

names.name: line_role:note
names.definition: a label and value outside a table

names.name: value_kind:marker
names.definition: a filled cell saying no value: -, n/a
